item.title: How to differentiate Amazon SNS vs Amazon SQS?
item.description: In what situations do we need to use Amazon SNS vs Amazon SQS (Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) versus Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS)), and what are the reasons for this? Answer by (Admin): Amazon SNS vs Amazon SQS are both messaging services provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS). However, they are designed for different use cases and have some key differences. Way to differentiate between Amazon SNS vs Amazon SQS: Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) is a push-based delivery system that uses a publish-subscribe model to send messages to subscribed endpoints or clients, while Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) is a pull-based delivery system that uses a queue-based system to store and retrieve messages between distributed application components.
